record.oneLiner: A robust tyrannosaurid predator of Laramidia.
record.description: Daspletosaurus was a large bipedal tyrannosaurid from Late Cretaceous Laramidia (western North America), closely related to the later, larger Tyrannosaurus. Several species are known from Alberta and Montana.

notableFacts.text: One of the closest known relatives of Tyrannosaurus.
More robustly built than the contemporary Gorgosaurus.
